root_cause: When MPS212 (Mpsp212 / parametric stereo) bitstream parsing support was added, the newly introduced bsOttBandsPhase and bsResidualBands fields were parsed straight from the bitstream with get_bits() but never range-checked against the numBands value implied by bsFreqRes, i.e. a missing input validation / bounds check on attacker-controlled bitstream fields that are later used as array bounds/indices.
findings: decode_usac_element_pair() reads the raw 5-bit bitstream fields bsOttBandsPhase (via get_bits(gb, 5)) into e->mps.otts_bands_phase, and, when residual coding is enabled, bsResidualBands into e->mps.residual_bands, without validating them against the maximum number of frequency bands (numBands) allowed for the current freq_res setting (per ISO/IEC 23003-1:2007 Table 39, numBands can be as small as
